meaning:
ἀντ-άλλαγμα, -τος, τό
(ἀντί, ἄλλαγμα; ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מְחִיר ;]
an exchange, the price received as an equivalent for an article of commerce: Mat.16:26, Mrk.8:37 (cf. Sir.26:14; and see Swete, Mk., l.with; Cremer, 90).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
For what will a man give in exchange for his life?
